spine.deviation_notes: The melee-strike-spawns-icy-projectiles identity lands as a two-geometry composite (melee_strike + multi_projectile) with GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade for the hit-to-fan propagation, but the engine expresses it as two discrete geometries rather than a single unified 'strike that emits a projectile fan' primitive. The 30%-less-damage fan and the exact 'behind the first target' spawn geometry are behavioral properties. A player keeps the engage-in-melee / damage-projects-behind feel; the tight coupling of one attack producing both hits is generalized to two linked geometries.

skills.delivery_notes: a cold melee strike on the targeted enemy with increased range; this primary hit is the every-3-sec dominant action. water/cold family; chill+freeze (native shatter payoff). Physical base but the build scales as a COLD attack (100% convert)

on the primary melee hit, releases a fan of 5-8 icy projectiles that fly at enemies BEHIND the first target (dealing 30% less than the strike). multi_projectile = the icy-blade fan; this is the clear/AoE half of the skill spawned by the melee hit

mapping_json.motion_frame: melee-into-ranged hybrid: strike the front enemy in melee, the hit spits a fan of icy blades through the pack behind it -- close to engage, but the damage projects outward

geometry: multi_projectile icy-blade fan (extra-projectiles support scales fan width)

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: COMPOSITE melee->projectile skill. The single source skill is TWO geometries: a melee_strike (primary, the dominant loop) that SPAWNS a multi_projectile fan behind the target. Modeled as two skill entries; the melee hit leads per s7.2 (what the player does every 3 sec = strike). water/cold family; chill+freeze on the strike, chill on the fan. Physical base -> 100% cold-converted, so it maps as a cold attack (element carries, unlike pure-physical melee). GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade routes the 'primary hit propagates damage outward to enemies behind' spawn identity (the fan IS a hit-spawned propagation); ELEMENTAL_ECHO for the mono-cold amp. The composite (one attack = melee + spawned projectiles) is faithfully two engine geometries; a player keeps the strike-front-hit-back identity.
